preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or have gained ownership)
Contract must have a non-zero BNB balance (either from token swap fees or direct transfers)

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the claimTokens() function to drain all BNB from the contract to the owner's address. This function has no limits and transfers the entire contract balance. Ensure the contract has accumulated BNB from token swap fees or send BNB to the contract first if needed.
